description: 对 v0.41 双 token 形成终点进行资源块置换、token 干预和位置重定位
research_question: 第二个 token 的功能是否可组合而非仅是冗余编码；共同协议对资源角色置换、token 删除/交换和未见空间关系的敏感性是什么？

interventions.mask_tokens: all seven vocabulary values are used as deterministic replacement values; no vocabulary item is assumed to be a reserved null symbol
interventions.swap_within_sender: exchange token0 and token1 for every resource and world
interventions.shuffle_token1: cyclically shift token1 across worlds while preserving token0
interventions.resource_block_permutations: all six permutations of the three two-token resource blocks; report literal target and jointly permuted target
interventions.site_relocations: identity plus five cyclic relabelings of six site IDs; photo identities stay fixed and positions are moved before sender encoding
interventions.held_out_relation: the v0.41 partition target60 relation split is retained as a predeclared novel ordered resource-position relation set

measurements: literal versus jointly permuted block score
limits: This is an endpoint intervention assay and does not add training or claim open-ended language.
The six-site world has no genuinely new image category; cyclic relocation tests spatial recombination under the same frozen visual bank.
A token mask value is an existing vocabulary symbol, so results are reported for all seven replacements rather than one arbitrary null token.
Resource block permutations are receiver-side counterfactuals; a later formation batch must train under full resource and role randomization.
